q: 他工作的时候喜欢___喝茶___听新闻。
zh: 他工作的时候喜欢一边喝茶一边听新闻。
py: tā gōng zuò de shí hou xǐ huan yī biān hē chá yī biān tīng xīn wén
en: When he works he likes to drink tea while listening to the news.
why: Two actions done at the same time are joined by 一边…一边. 越…越 links two things that grow together, and 不是…就是 means 'one or the other'.

q: 我们___上课，___去图书馆。
zh: 我们先上课，然后去图书馆。
py: wǒ men xiān shàng kè rán hòu qù tú shū guǎn
en: First we have class, then we go to the library.
why: Two steps in order are 先…然后. 一…就 would mean 'as soon as', and 不是…就是 would mean 'one or the other'.

q: 他越跑___快，最后跑到了第一名。
zh: 他越跑越快，最后跑到了第一名。
py: tā yuè pǎo yuè kuài zuì hòu pǎo dào le dì yì míng
en: The more he ran, the faster he got, and in the end he came first.
why: 越…越 needs the second 越 right before the adjective: the more he ran, the faster. 很, 更 and 最 cannot echo the first 越.

q: ___老师生病了，___今天的课改到下周了。
zh: 因为老师生病了，所以今天的课改到下周了。
py: yīn wèi lǎo shī shēng bìng le suǒ yǐ jīn tiān de kè gǎi dào xià zhōu le
en: Because the teacher is ill, today's class has been moved to next week.
why: Cause and result are paired as 因为…所以. 虽然…但是 would call the illness and the change contradictory, and 如果…就 would make the illness only a possibility although it has happened.

src_py: tā huí dào jiā rán hòu zuò fàn
task: Rewrite with 一…就 (as soon as).
zh: 他一回到家就做饭。
py: tā yī huí dào jiā jiù zuò fàn
en: He cooks as soon as he gets home.
why: 一 goes right before the first verb 回 and 就 before the second action, both after the subject 他. 然后 is dropped.

q: 他虽然已经工作了十年，___还是每天学习新东西。
zh: 他虽然已经工作了十年，但是还是每天学习新东西。
py: tā suī rán yǐ jīng gōng zuò le shí nián dàn shì hái shi měi tiān xué xí xīn dōng xi
en: Although he has already worked for ten years, he still learns new things every day.
why: 虽然 is answered by 但是 (or 可是) before the main clause, and 还是 adds 'still'. 所以 gives a cause that does not exist, and 就 or 才 would need an if or only-if clause.

q: 因为今天有考试，___我昨晚学到很晚。
zh: 因为今天有考试，所以我昨晚学到很晚。
py: yīn wèi jīn tiān yǒu kǎo shì suǒ yǐ wǒ zuó wǎn xué dào hěn wǎn
en: Because there's an exam today, I studied until very late last night.
why: 所以 introduces the result of 因为 and stands before the second subject 我. 但是 would contrast, 而且 would add, and 如果 would make the exam hypothetical when it is real.

zh: 不但学生们喜欢这位老师，而且家长们也喜欢他。
py: bù dàn xué sheng men xǐ huan zhè wèi lǎo shī ér qiě jiā zhǎng men yě xǐ huan tā
en: Not only do the students like this teacher, the parents like him too.
why: With two different subjects, 不但 comes before the first subject. 而且 is a conjunction before the second subject, and 也 follows 家长们.

q: 我们先把新员工的培训安排好，___再讨论工资的问题。
zh: 我们先把新员工的培训安排好，然后再讨论工资的问题。
py: wǒ men xiān bǎ xīn yuán gōng de péi xùn ān pái hǎo rán hòu zài tǎo lùn gōng zī de wèn tí
en: First we'll arrange the new staff's training, and then discuss the salary question.
why: 先…然后(再) lines up two steps, and 然后 can open the second step before 再. 所以, 但是 and 因为 give consequence, contrast and cause instead of order.

q: ___明天下大雨，我们也要去参观工厂。
zh: 即使明天下大雨，我们也要去参观工厂。
py: jí shǐ míng tiān xià dà yǔ wǒ men yě yào qù cān guān gōng chǎng
en: Even if it pours tomorrow, we're still going to visit the factory.
why: 明天 has not happened, so this is a supposed case: 即使 ('even if') with 也. 虽然 needs a real fact, 因为 gives a cause, and 既然 needs something already known.

s: 尽管任务很难，他们还是按时完成了。
s_py: jǐn guǎn rèn wù hěn nán tā men hái shi àn shí wán chéng le
zh: 尽管任务很难，他们还是按时完成了。
py: jǐn guǎn rèn wù hěn nán tā men hái shi àn shí wán chéng le
en: Even though the task was hard, they still finished on time.
why: 尽管 states a real fact and pairs with 还是 after the subject 他们; no 但是 is needed. The sentence is correct.

q: 我一看到这个题，___知道怎么做。
zh: 我一看到这个题，就知道怎么做。
py: wǒ yī kàn dào zhè ge tí jiù zhī dao zěn me zuò
en: As soon as I saw this question, I knew how to do it.
why: 一 + verb + 就 means 'as soon as ... then': 就 follows the second subject. 再 would mean 'then, later', and 也 or 还 do not mark immediacy.

q: 尽管作业很多，他___去打篮球了。
zh: 尽管作业很多，他还是去打篮球了。
py: jǐn guǎn zuò yè hěn duō tā hái shi qù dǎ lán qiú le
en: Even though he had a lot of homework, he still went to play basketball.
why: 尽管 states a real fact and is answered by 还是 after the subject 他: 'still'. 才 means 'only then', 又 means 'again', and 但是 cannot stand after the subject.

q: 这次出差不是去上海，___去北京。
zh: 这次出差不是去上海，而是去北京。
py: zhè cì chū chāi bú shì qù shàng hǎi ér shì qù běi jīng
en: This business trip is not to Shanghai but to Beijing.
why: Correcting a wrong assumption ('not A but B') is 不是…而是. 就是 would mean 'if not A then B', and 但是 or 还是 cannot follow 不是 this way.

src: 如果你多练习，就能说得更好。
src_py: rú guǒ nǐ duō liàn xí jiù néng shuō de gèng hǎo
zh: 只有多练习，你才能说得更好。
py: zhǐ yǒu duō liàn xí nǐ cái néng shuō de gèng hǎo
en: Only if you practise a lot can you speak better.
why: 只有 replaces 如果 and its partner changes from 就 to 才, after 你. Keeping 就 would be wrong.

q: 如果明天不上课，我___去图书馆。
zh: 如果明天不上课，我就去图书馆。
py: rú guǒ míng tiān bù shàng kè wǒ jiù qù tú shū guǎn
en: If there's no class tomorrow, I'll go to the library.
why: 如果 takes 就 after the second subject 我. 才 would turn it into 'only then', which belongs to 只有; 都 and 还 do not complete the 如果 clause.

q: 虽然工作很多，___我很开心。
zh: 虽然工作很多，但是我很开心。
py: suī rán gōng zuò hěn duō dàn shì wǒ hěn kāi xīn
en: Although there is a lot of work, I'm happy.
why: 但是 is a conjunction and opens the second clause before the subject 我. The adverbs 也, 都 and 才 must follow 我 and can never stand in front of it.

zh: 这份工作又轻松又有意思。
py: zhè fèn gōng zuò yòu qīng sōng yòu yǒu yì si
en: This job is both easy and interesting.
why: 又…又 puts one 又 before each quality, with no 很. Both 又 follow the topic 这份工作 and stand right before the adjectives.

q: ___昨天已经复习了三遍，他考得还是不好。
zh: 虽然昨天已经复习了三遍，他考得还是不好。
py: suī rán zuó tiān yǐ jīng fù xí le sān biàn tā kǎo de hái shi bù hǎo
en: Although he had already revised three times yesterday, he still did badly in the exam.
why: 已经 shows this is a real, finished fact, so 虽然 (although) fits. 即使 and 如果 suppose a case that has not happened, and 因为 would make revising the cause of doing badly.

q: 只要你准备好了，___就可以开始。
zh: 只要你准备好了，我们就可以开始。
py: zhǐ yào nǐ zhǔn bèi hǎo le wǒ men jiù kě yǐ kāi shǐ
en: As long as you're ready, we can begin.
why: 就 is an adverb and must follow a subject, so the second clause needs its own subject 我们 before it. 所以, 但是 and 而且 are conjunctions that cannot stand in front of 就 here.

zh: 即使明天没有会议，他也会来公司。
py: jí shǐ míng tiān méi yǒu huì yì tā yě huì lái gōng sī
en: Even if there's no meeting tomorrow, he will come to the office.
why: 即使 supposes a case, and its partner 也 follows the second subject 他. 但是 does not fit a supposed case, and 也 cannot stand before 他.

zh: 如果你不去开会，我就不去了。
py: rú guǒ nǐ bù qù kāi huì wǒ jiù bù qù le
en: If you're not going to the meeting, I won't go either.
why: The adverb 就 must follow the second subject 我, so the order is 我 + 就 + verb. Putting 就 before 我 treats it like a conjunction, which it is not.

zh: 她一边听老师讲课，一边做笔记。
py: tā yī biān tīng lǎo shī jiǎng kè yī biān zuò bǐ jì
en: She takes notes while listening to the teacher's lecture.
why: 一边…一边 joins two actions done at the same time, each 一边 right before its verb and after the subject 她.

zh: 不管工作多忙，他都会去运动。
py: bù guǎn gōng zuò duō máng tā dōu huì qù yùn dòng
en: No matter how busy work is, he always goes to exercise.
why: 不管 comes first with a question form (多忙), then the subject; 都 follows 他 and stands before 会. 都 cannot come before 他.

zh: 他越学越有兴趣。
py: tā yuè xué yuè yǒu xìng qù
en: The more he studies, the more interested he becomes.
why: 越…越 links two changes that grow together: studying more and interest rising. 越来越 would only say that something grows over time.

zh: 虽然这个任务很难，但是我们完成了。
py: suī rán zhè ge rèn wù hěn nán dàn shì wǒ men wán chéng le
en: Although this task was hard, we completed it.
why: 虽然 opens the first clause, and the conjunction 但是 opens the second one before its subject 我们. English drops 'but', Chinese keeps it.

s: 只有提前报名，你就可以参加比赛。
s_py: zhǐ yǒu tí qián bào míng nǐ jiù kě yǐ cān jiā bǐ sài
zh: 只有提前报名，你才可以参加比赛。
py: zhǐ yǒu tí qián bào míng nǐ cái kě yǐ cān jiā bǐ sài
en: You can take part in the competition only if you sign up in advance.
why: 只有 names the one condition that works, so its partner is 才. 就 belongs with 只要 and 如果.

q: ___你通过面试，___能进这家公司。
zh: 只有你通过面试，才能进这家公司。
py: zhǐ yǒu nǐ tōng guò miàn shì cái néng jìn zhè jiā gōng sī
en: Only if you pass the interview can you join this company.
why: 'Only if' is 只有 and its partner is 才. 只要 or 如果 take 就, and a mixed pair such as 只要…才 does not exist.

zh: 老师一进教室，同学们就安静了。
py: lǎo shī yī jìn jiào shì tóng xué men jiù ān jìng le
en: As soon as the teacher came into the classroom, the students went quiet.
why: 一 stands right before the first verb 进 and 就 right after the second subject 同学们. Neither can move to the front of its clause.

s: 雨越下越大，我们回家吧。
s_py: yǔ yuè xià yuè dà wǒ men huí jiā ba
zh: 雨越下越大，我们回家吧。
py: yǔ yuè xià yuè dà wǒ men huí jiā ba
en: The rain is getting heavier and heavier, so let's go home.
why: Before an action verb like 下 the pattern is 越 + verb + 越 + adjective, not 越来越. The sentence is correct.

s: 不管天气怎么样，都我们去学校。
s_py: bù guǎn tiān qì zěn me yàng dōu wǒ men qù xué xiào
zh: 不管天气怎么样，我们都去学校。
py: bù guǎn tiān qì zěn me yàng wǒ men dōu qù xué xiào
en: Whatever the weather is like, we go to school.
why: 都 is an adverb and must follow the second subject 我们. It cannot stand in front of it.

s: 一我到学校，就给你打电话。
s_py: yī wǒ dào xué xiào jiù gěi nǐ dǎ diàn huà
zh: 我一到学校，就给你打电话。
py: wǒ yī dào xué xiào jiù gěi nǐ dǎ diàn huà
en: I'll call you as soon as I get to school.
why: 一 must stand after the subject, right before the verb 到. It cannot head the clause before 我.

q: ___他的普通话不太标准，___大家都听得懂。
zh: 虽然他的普通话不太标准，但是大家都听得懂。
py: suī rán tā de pǔ tōng huà bù tài biāo zhǔn dàn shì dà jiā dōu tīng de dǒng
en: Although his Mandarin isn't very standard, everyone can understand him.
why: The first clause states a real fact and the second contrasts with it: 虽然…但是. 因为…所以 and 只要…就 give cause and condition, which would not make sense of 'not standard, yet understood'.

q: 只要明天不下雨，运动会___照常举行。
zh: 只要明天不下雨，运动会就照常举行。
py: zhǐ yào míng tiān bù xià yǔ yùn dòng huì jiù zhào cháng jǔ xíng
en: As long as it doesn't rain tomorrow, the sports day will go ahead as usual.
why: 只要 gives a sufficient condition, so the partner is 就. 才 would require 只有, and 却 or 因此 give contrast or consequence instead of a condition.

zh: 要么你明天来，要么我后天去找你。
py: yào me nǐ míng tiān lái yào me wǒ hòu tiān qù zhǎo nǐ
en: Either you come tomorrow, or I'll come and find you the day after.
why: 要么…要么 offers two options, and each 要么 stands at the head of its clause, before the subject. 不是…就是 would not offer a choice.

q: 不管天气怎么样，学生们___要去上学。
zh: 不管天气怎么样，学生们都要去上学。
py: bù guǎn tiān qì zěn me yàng xué sheng men dōu yào qù shàng xué
en: Whatever the weather is like, the students have to go to school.
why: 不管 + a question form (怎么样) is answered by 都, which says every case is the same. 就 and 才 belong to if and only-if sentences, and 又 means 'again'.

q: 只有多练习，你___能考好。
zh: 只有多练习，你才能考好。
py: zhǐ yǒu duō liàn xí nǐ cái néng kǎo hǎo
en: Only by practising a lot can you do well in the exam.
why: 只有 ('only if') names the one condition that works, so its partner is 才. 就 goes with 只要 or 如果, and 也 or 都 are not partners of 只有.

q: 他的中文说得越来越___。
zh: 他的中文说得越来越流利。
py: tā de zhōng wén shuō de yuè lái yuè liú lì
en: His Chinese is getting more and more fluent.
why: 越来越 expresses change over time and takes a bare adjective. A degree word such as 很, 非常 or 更 clashes with 越来越.

q: 同学们先读课文，___做练习。
zh: 同学们先读课文，再做练习。
py: tóng xué men xiān dú kè wén zài zuò liàn xí
en: The students read the text first and then do the exercises.
why: 先 marks step one and 再 the next step, as a plan. 又 would mean 'again', 却 would contrast, and 都 does not mark order.

s: 这家咖啡馆一边便宜一边好喝。
s_py: zhè jiā kā fēi guǎn yī biān pián yi yī biān hǎo hē
zh: 这家咖啡馆又便宜又好喝。
py: zhè jiā kā fēi guǎn yòu pián yi yòu hǎo hē
en: This cafe is both cheap and tasty.
why: 一边…一边 is only for two actions done at the same time. Two qualities of one thing are joined with 又…又.

q: 不管___忙，他每天都练习写汉字。
zh: 不管多忙，他每天都练习写汉字。
py: bù guǎn duō máng tā měi tiān dōu liàn xí xiě hàn zì
en: However busy he is, he practises writing characters every day.
why: 不管 needs an open question form, and 多 + adjective ('how busy') supplies it. 很, 太 and 真 state a fact, which 不管 cannot take.

zh: 我们先开会，再讨论预算。
py: wǒ men xiān kāi huì zài tǎo lùn yù suàn
en: We'll hold the meeting first and then discuss the budget.
why: 先 marks the first step and 再 the next; both are adverbs placed right before their verbs. 再 cannot open the second step in front of its verb phrase.

s: 不但经理同意了，而且老板也同意了。
s_py: bù dàn jīng lǐ tóng yì le ér qiě lǎo bǎn yě tóng yì le
zh: 不但经理同意了，而且老板也同意了。
py: bù dàn jīng lǐ tóng yì le ér qiě lǎo bǎn yě tóng yì le
en: Not only did the manager agree, the boss agreed too.
why: The clauses have different subjects, so 不但 stands before the first; 而且 opens the second clause and 也 follows 老板. The sentence is correct.

q: 这位同事___很认真，___很友好。
zh: 这位同事不但很认真，而且很友好。
py: zhè wèi tóng shì bù dàn hěn rèn zhēn ér qiě hěn yǒu hǎo
en: This colleague is not only conscientious but also friendly.
why: Two good qualities are added together with 不但…而且. 虽然…但是 would make them clash, and 因为…所以 would make one quality cause the other.

q: 除了周五，我每天___要开会。
zh: 除了周五，我每天都要开会。
py: chú le zhōu wǔ wǒ měi tiān dōu yào kāi huì
en: I have a meeting every day except Friday.
why: Friday is the exception, so the partner is 都 after 每天. 还 would add Friday as one more day, which contradicts 'except'.

s: 我不是在写报告，但是在开会。
s_py: wǒ bú shì zài xiě bào gào dàn shì zài kāi huì
zh: 我不是在写报告，而是在开会。
py: wǒ bú shì zài xiě bào gào ér shì zài kāi huì
en: I'm not writing a report; I'm in a meeting.
why: Correcting what someone assumes is 不是…而是. 但是 cannot answer 不是 in this way.

q: 小李___到公司就开电脑。
zh: 小李一到公司就开电脑。
py: xiǎo lǐ yī dào gōng sī jiù kāi diàn nǎo
en: Xiao Li switches on the computer as soon as he gets to the office.
why: 一 + verb + 就 means 'as soon as': 一 goes right before the first verb. 先 would need 再 or 然后 as its partner, not 就.

q: 除了工作以外，他___喜欢爬山。
zh: 除了工作以外，他还喜欢爬山。
py: chú le gōng zuò yǐ wài tā hái xǐ huan pá shān
en: Besides work, he also likes hiking.
why: Adding a second interest is 除了…以外 + 还: 'besides work, also hiking'. 都 would mean 'everything except work', which does not fit one added hobby.

q: 办公室里越来越___了。
zh: 办公室里越来越热了。
py: bàn gōng shì lǐ yuè lái yuè rè le
en: The office is getting hotter and hotter.
why: 越来越 already means 'more and more', so the adjective stands bare. 很, 非常 and 太 cannot follow it.

s: 就算你不同意，但是我也要做。
s_py: jiù suàn nǐ bù tóng yì dàn shì wǒ yě yào zuò
zh: 就算你不同意，我也要做。
py: jiù suàn nǐ bù tóng yì wǒ yě yào zuò
en: Even if you don't agree, I'm going to do it.
why: 就算 supposes a case and is answered by 也 after the subject. 但是 belongs with 虽然, which states a real fact, and cannot be added here.

q: 只要你认真听课，___能听懂。
zh: 只要你认真听课，就能听懂。
py: zhǐ yào nǐ rèn zhēn tīng kè jiù néng tīng dǒng
en: As long as you listen carefully in class, you'll understand.
why: 只要 ('as long as') takes 就: listening carefully is enough. 才 belongs to 只有, and 但是 or 所以 would give a contrast or a cause.

q: 小王不但会说英语，___会说日语。
zh: 小王不但会说英语，而且会说日语。
py: xiǎo wáng bù dàn huì shuō yīng yǔ ér qiě huì shuō rì yǔ
en: Xiao Wang can not only speak English but can also speak Japanese.
why: 不但 is answered by 而且 ('but also'). 但是 would contrast, 所以 would give a result, and 虽然 would need its own 但是.

zh: 只有认真复习，小王才能考好。
py: zhǐ yǒu rèn zhēn fù xí xiǎo wáng cái néng kǎo hǎo
en: Only by revising carefully can Xiao Wang do well in the exam.
why: 只有 names the one way, and its partner 才 sits after the subject 小王, directly before 能. 就 does not go with 只有.

q: ___提高口语，她每天都和同学练习说中文。
zh: 为了提高口语，她每天都和同学练习说中文。
py: wèi le tí gāo kǒu yǔ tā měi tiān dōu hé tóng xué liàn xí shuō zhōng wén
en: To improve her spoken Chinese, she practises speaking with classmates every day.
why: Improving her speaking is the goal of the daily practice, not a reason that already exists, so 为了 is needed. 因为 would turn the goal into a cause, and 所以 or 虽然 cannot open the sentence.

q: 虽然这道题很难，___我还是做对了。
zh: 虽然这道题很难，但是我还是做对了。
py: suī rán zhè dào tí hěn nán dàn shì wǒ hái shi zuò duì le
en: Although this question was hard, I still got it right.
why: 虽然 states a fact and its partner 但是 opens the second clause, even though English drops 'but'. 所以 and 而且 give the wrong relation, and 如果 would make the difficulty hypothetical.

q: 无论老板同意___不同意，我们都要按时交报告。
zh: 无论老板同意还是不同意，我们都要按时交报告。
py: wú lùn lǎo bǎn tóng yì hái shi bù tóng yì wǒ men dōu yào àn shí jiāo bào gào
en: Whether the boss agrees or not, we must hand in the report on time.
why: 无论 needs both possibilities joined as a choice: 同意还是不同意. 和 joins things and does not offer alternatives, and 而是 or 所以 give other relations.

zh: 因为经理出差了，所以会议取消了。
py: yīn wèi jīng lǐ chū chāi le suǒ yǐ huì yì qǔ xiāo le
en: Because the manager went away on business, the meeting was cancelled.
why: 所以 is a conjunction: it stands before the result clause and its subject 会议. 因为 opens the reason clause, so neither can move after the subject.

zh: 我不是不想去，而是没有时间。
py: wǒ bú shì bù xiǎng qù ér shì méi yǒu shí jiān
en: It's not that I don't want to go; I just don't have time.
why: 不是 A 而是 B corrects a wrong guess: 而是 begins the real reason. 但是 or 就是 would change the relation between the two parts.

q: 不管___来开会，我们都欢迎。
zh: 不管谁来开会，我们都欢迎。
py: bù guǎn shuí lái kāi huì wǒ men dōu huān yíng
en: We welcome whoever comes to the meeting.
why: 不管 needs a question word, so 谁 makes it 'whoever'. 他, 大家 and 我们 name a definite group, so nothing is left open for 都 to cover.

q: 她既是我的老师，___是我的朋友。
zh: 她既是我的老师，也是我的朋友。
py: tā jì shì wǒ de lǎo shī yě shì wǒ de péng you
en: She is both my teacher and my friend.
why: 既 is answered by 也 or 又: 'both ... and'. 才 and 就 are condition partners, and 都 would need a plural subject.

q: 他每次出差，不是坐飞机，___坐高铁，从来不自己开车。
zh: 他每次出差，不是坐飞机，就是坐高铁，从来不自己开车。
py: tā měi cì chū chāi bú shì zuò fēi jī jiù shì zuò gāo tiě cóng lái bù zì jǐ kāi chē
en: Whenever he travels on business he either flies or takes the high-speed train; he never drives himself.
why: Two habitual possibilities with nothing else allowed: 不是…就是. 而是 would deny the first and assert the second, and 要么 cannot follow 不是.

q: 雨___下越大，我们只好回教室了。
zh: 雨越下越大，我们只好回教室了。
py: yǔ yuè xià yuè dà wǒ men zhǐ hǎo huí jiào shì le
en: The longer it rained, the harder it came down, so we had to go back to the classroom.
why: 越 + verb + 越 + adjective links the rain falling and its force. 越来越 cannot sit directly before an action verb like 下.

q: 除了英语，她___会说法语。
zh: 除了英语，她还会说法语。
py: chú le yīng yǔ tā hái huì shuō fǎ yǔ
en: Besides English, she can also speak French.
why: Adding another item is 除了 + 还: 'besides English, also French'. 都 would mean 'everything except English', which does not fit one extra language.

q: 因为路上堵车，___我迟到了。
zh: 因为路上堵车，所以我迟到了。
py: yīn wèi lù shàng dǔ chē suǒ yǐ wǒ chí dào le
en: Because of the traffic jam, I was late.
why: 所以 is a conjunction that goes before the second subject 我. 也, 都 and 还 are adverbs, which can only come after 我.

zh: 如果明天不下雨，我们就去参观工厂。
py: rú guǒ míng tiān bù xià yǔ wǒ men jiù qù cān guān gōng chǎng
en: If it doesn't rain tomorrow, we'll go and visit the factory.
why: 如果 + condition, then 就 directly after the second subject 我们. 就 cannot stand before 我们.

src: 虽然他很累，但是他还在工作。
src_py: suī rán tā hěn lèi dàn shì tā hái zài gōng zuò
task: Rewrite with 尽管 and 还是.
zh: 尽管他很累，他还是在工作。
py: jǐn guǎn tā hěn lèi tā hái shi zài gōng zuò
en: Even though he was tired, he was still working.
why: 尽管 replaces 虽然 and 还是 replaces 但是. 还是 is an adverb, so it follows the second 他.

q: 他又高又___帅。
zh: 他又高又帅。
py: tā yòu gāo yòu shuài
en: He is both tall and handsome.
why: 又…又 takes bare adjectives, so 很 may not stand inside it: leave the blank empty.

q: 由于经理临时出差了，___今天的会议取消了。
zh: 由于经理临时出差了，因此今天的会议取消了。
py: yóu yú jīng lǐ lín shí chū chāi le yīn cǐ jīn tiān de huì yì qǔ xiāo le
en: Because the manager suddenly went away on business, today's meeting was cancelled.
why: 由于 gives the reason and 因此 starts the result. 因为 cannot head a result clause, and 如果 or 可是 would express condition or contrast instead of consequence.

q: 他一下班___回家休息。
zh: 他一下班就回家休息。
py: tā yī xià bān jiù huí jiā xiū xi
en: He goes home to rest as soon as he gets off work.
why: 一…就 means 'as soon as': the second action follows at once. 才 would say it happens late, which clashes with 一.

q: ___公司最近订单很多，___大家周末也要加班。
zh: 由于公司最近订单很多，因此大家周末也要加班。
py: yóu yú gōng sī zuì jìn dìng dān hěn duō yīn cǐ dà jiā zhōu mò yě yào jiā bān
en: Because the company has had many orders lately, everyone has to work overtime at weekends too.
why: 由于 gives the reason and 因此 the consequence. 可是 and 但是 would mark a contrast that the meaning does not have, and 既然…就 would need a suggestion, not a plain consequence.

q: 只有提前预约，客人___能进会议室。
zh: 只有提前预约，客人才能进会议室。
py: zhǐ yǒu tí qián yù yuē kè ren cái néng jìn huì yì shì
en: Guests can enter the meeting room only if they book in advance.
why: 只有 sets the single condition and takes 才 after the subject 客人. 就 would suit 只要 and 如果 but not 只有.

s: 我的汉语越来越非常好了。
s_py: wǒ de hàn yǔ yuè lái yuè fēi cháng hǎo le
zh: 我的汉语越来越好了。
py: wǒ de hàn yǔ yuè lái yuè hǎo le
en: My Chinese is getting better and better.
why: 越来越 already carries the degree, so 非常 cannot follow it. The bare adjective 好 is enough.

s: 既然天气不好，我们就在教室里吃午饭吧。
s_py: jì rán tiān qì bù hǎo wǒ men jiù zài jiào shì lǐ chī wǔ fàn ba
zh: 既然天气不好，我们就在教室里吃午饭吧。
py: jì rán tiān qì bù hǎo wǒ men jiù zài jiào shì lǐ chī wǔ fàn ba
en: Since the weather is bad, let's eat lunch in the classroom.
why: 既然 takes 就 after the second subject 我们, with no 所以. The sentence is correct.

q: 周末他不是看书，___睡觉，从来不出门。
zh: 周末他不是看书，就是睡觉，从来不出门。
py: zhōu mò tā bú shì kàn shū jiù shì shuì jiào cóng lái bù chū mén
en: At weekends he's always either reading or sleeping, and he never goes out.
why: 'Always one of these two' is 不是…就是. 而是 would be a correction ('not reading but sleeping'), and 要么 cannot follow 不是.

zh: 除了星期六，我们每天都上班。
py: chú le xīng qī liù wǒ men měi tiān dōu shàng bān
en: We work every day except Saturday.
why: 除了 + 都 means 'all except': 都 stands after 每天, right before the verb. 还 would add Saturday instead of excluding it.

s: 不管他很忙，他都会来开会。
s_py: bù guǎn tā hěn máng tā dōu huì lái kāi huì
zh: 不管他多忙，他都会来开会。
py: bù guǎn tā duō máng tā dōu huì lái kāi huì
en: However busy he is, he always comes to the meeting.
why: 不管 must be followed by an open question form such as 多忙 ('how busy'). 很忙 is a plain statement, which 不管 cannot take.

s: 除了小李，大家都来了。
s_py: chú le xiǎo lǐ dà jiā dōu lái le
zh: 除了小李，大家都来了。
py: chú le xiǎo lǐ dà jiā dōu lái le
en: Everyone came except Xiao Li.
why: 'All except' is 除了 + 都, with 都 after the subject 大家. The sentence is correct.

q: 要是你的表格明天上午还没交，经理___会不高兴的。
zh: 要是你的表格明天上午还没交，经理就会不高兴的。
py: yào shì nǐ de biǎo gé míng tiān shàng wǔ hái méi jiāo jīng lǐ jiù huì bù gāo xìng de
en: If your form still hasn't been handed in by tomorrow morning, the manager will be unhappy.
why: 要是 pairs with 就 after the second subject 经理. 才 would say 'only then', and 都 or 却 do not complete an if-clause.

q: ___你把文件发给我，___我明天去你办公室拿。
zh: 要么你把文件发给我，要么我明天去你办公室拿。
py: yào me nǐ bǎ wén jiàn fā gěi wǒ yào me wǒ míng tiān qù nǐ bàn gōng shì ná
en: Either you send me the file, or I'll come to your office tomorrow to pick it up.
why: Two options offered for the listener to choose from are 要么…要么. 不是…就是 states what is always the case, and 不是…而是 corrects a mistake.

s: 不管多忙，他都会给家人打电话。
s_py: bù guǎn duō máng tā dōu huì gěi jiā rén dǎ diàn huà
zh: 不管多忙，他都会给家人打电话。
py: bù guǎn duō máng tā dōu huì gěi jiā rén dǎ diàn huà
en: However busy he is, he always phones his family.
why: 多忙 ('how busy') is the open question 不管 needs, and 都 follows the subject 他. The sentence is correct.

s: 他一边走路一边打电话。
s_py: tā yī biān zǒu lù yī biān dǎ diàn huà
zh: 他一边走路一边打电话。
py: tā yī biān zǒu lù yī biān dǎ diàn huà
en: He talks on the phone while walking.
why: Two actions at the same time take 一边…一边, each right before its verb. The sentence is correct.

s: 除了周六，同学们每天还来教室。
s_py: chú le zhōu liù tóng xué men měi tiān hái lái jiào shì
zh: 除了周六，同学们每天都来教室。
py: chú le zhōu liù tóng xué men měi tiān dōu lái jiào shì
en: The students come to the classroom every day except Saturday.
why: Saturday is the exception, so the partner is 都. 还 means 'also' and would add Saturday instead of excluding it.

s: 只有经理同意，这个计划才能开始。
s_py: zhǐ yǒu jīng lǐ tóng yì zhè ge jì huà cái néng kāi shǐ
zh: 只有经理同意，这个计划才能开始。
py: zhǐ yǒu jīng lǐ tóng yì zhè ge jì huà cái néng kāi shǐ
en: This plan can only start if the manager agrees.
why: 只有 is answered by 才 after the subject 这个计划, and 就 is not allowed. The sentence is correct.

q: 除了小李，我们班的同学___参加了比赛。
zh: 除了小李，我们班的同学都参加了比赛。
py: chú le xiǎo lǐ wǒ men bān de tóng xué dōu cān jiā le bǐ sài
en: Everyone in our class took part in the competition except Xiao Li.
why: 'Everyone except Xiao Li' is 除了 + 都. 还 and 也 would say 'besides Xiao Li, the others also took part', and 才 means 'only then'.

q: 不管公司给的工资多高，他___不愿意离开家乡。
zh: 不管公司给的工资多高，他都不愿意离开家乡。
py: bù guǎn gōng sī gěi de gōng zī duō gāo tā dōu bù yuàn yì lí kāi jiā xiāng
en: No matter how high a salary the company offers, he is unwilling to leave his hometown.
why: 不管 + 多高 (open question) is answered by 都 after the subject 他. 就 and 才 belong to if and only-if sentences, and 却 would give a contrast without the 'any case' meaning.

zh: 既然你已经同意了，我们就开始吧。
py: jì rán nǐ yǐ jīng tóng yì le wǒ men jiù kāi shǐ ba
en: Since you've already agreed, let's start.
why: 既然 takes 就 after the second subject 我们, with no 所以 in between. 就 cannot move in front of 我们.

q: 他既会写程序，___会做设计。
zh: 他既会写程序，又会做设计。
py: tā jì huì xiě chéng xù yòu huì zuò shè jì
en: He can both write programs and do design.
why: 既…又 joins two abilities in the same pattern: 既会…又会…. 就 and 才 are condition partners, and 但 would mark a contrast.

s: 小王又聪明也努力。
s_py: xiǎo wáng yòu cōng ming yě nǔ lì
zh: 小王又聪明又努力。
py: xiǎo wáng yòu cōng ming yòu nǔ lì
en: Xiao Wang is both clever and hardworking.
why: 又 pairs with another 又 here. 也 cannot be the partner of 又 in this pattern.

q: 既然你已经做完作业了，我们___去看电影吧。
zh: 既然你已经做完作业了，我们就去看电影吧。
py: jì rán nǐ yǐ jīng zuò wán zuò yè le wǒ men jiù qù kàn diàn yǐng ba
en: Since you've finished your homework, let's go and see a film.
why: 既然 (since) takes 就 after the second subject 我们 and leads to a suggestion. 才 would mean 'only then', which clashes with a plain suggestion; 都 and 却 do not link a suggestion to a known fact.

s: 因为通过考试，他每天复习到很晚。
s_py: yīn wèi tōng guò kǎo shì tā měi tiān fù xí dào hěn wǎn
zh: 为了通过考试，他每天复习到很晚。
py: wèi le tōng guò kǎo shì tā měi tiān fù xí dào hěn wǎn
en: He revises until late every day in order to pass the exam.
why: Passing the exam is the goal of the revision, not its cause, so 为了 is needed. 因为 would claim the exam was already passed.

q: 即使老板不同意，我___要把这个方案做完。
zh: 即使老板不同意，我也要把这个方案做完。
py: jí shǐ lǎo bǎn bù tóng yì wǒ yě yào bǎ zhè ge fāng àn zuò wán
en: Even if the boss doesn't agree, I'm going to finish this plan.
why: 即使 supposes a case and takes 也 after the second subject 我. 才 means 'only then', and 所以 or 而且 are conjunctions that give cause or addition instead of 'even so'.

zh: 你先写名字，再填电话号码。
py: nǐ xiān xiě míng zì zài tián diàn huà hào mǎ
en: Write your name first, then fill in your phone number.
why: 先 marks the first step and 再 the second; both are adverbs right before their verbs, so 再 cannot stand before the subject 你 or at the end.

s: 只要你认真准备，就一定能通过面试。
s_py: zhǐ yào nǐ rèn zhēn zhǔn bèi jiù yí dìng néng tōng guò miàn shì
zh: 只要你认真准备，就一定能通过面试。
py: zhǐ yào nǐ rèn zhēn zhǔn bèi jiù yí dìng néng tōng guò miàn shì
en: As long as you prepare carefully, you'll certainly pass the interview.
why: The second clause shares the subject 你, so 就 simply opens it and needs no subject in front. The sentence is correct.

zh: 他的汉字写得越来越好了。
py: tā de hàn zì xiě de yuè lái yuè hǎo le
en: His Chinese characters are getting better and better.
why: 越来越 stands right before the adjective 好 with no 很, and 了 at the end marks the change over time.

src_py: zhè jiān jiào shì hěn dà yě hěn liàng
zh: 这间教室又大又亮。
py: zhè jiān jiào shì yòu dà yòu liàng
en: This classroom is both big and bright.
why: 又…又 joins two bare adjectives, so 很 and 也 are dropped.

q: 我越来越___这份工作了。
zh: 我越来越喜欢这份工作了。
py: wǒ yuè lái yuè xǐ huan zhè fèn gōng zuò le
en: I like this job more and more.
why: 越来越 can take a feeling verb such as 喜欢, but no degree word. 很 and 特别 duplicate the degree, and 越 is already inside 越来越.

q: 只有经理签字，这份合同___有效。
zh: 只有经理签字，这份合同才有效。
py: zhǐ yǒu jīng lǐ qiān zì zhè fèn hé tóng cái yǒu xiào
en: This contract is valid only if the manager signs it.
why: 'Only if the manager signs' is 只有 + 才. 就 would make the signature one of several enough conditions, which is the meaning of 只要.

zh: 为了提高成绩，同学们每天都复习。
py: wèi le tí gāo chéng jì tóng xué men měi tiān dōu fù xí
en: To raise their grades, the students review every day.
why: 为了 + goal gives the purpose of the action and stands before the main verb phrase. 都 follows 每天 and stands right before 复习.

src_py: zuì jìn wǒ de gōng zuò hěn máng
task: Say it is getting busier and busier.
zh: 最近，我的工作越来越忙了。
py: zuì jìn wǒ de gōng zuò yuè lái yuè máng le
en: My work has been getting busier and busier lately.
why: 越来越 replaces 很 and sits right before the adjective; 了 at the end marks the change. 很 cannot stay.

q: 这个会议室又大___亮。
zh: 这个会议室又大又亮。
py: zhè ge huì yì shì yòu dà yòu liàng
en: This meeting room is both big and bright.
why: 又…又 joins two qualities of the same thing: 又大又亮. 也, 还 and 再 do not pair with the first 又.
